title: [13.7] BEST VAYNE TOP IN DEPTH GUIDE Detailed Match Up Sheet Included
author: SaskioLoL
general: Vayne top heavily outscales with levels and items, so against melee lanes control the brushes, contest every last hit and deny farm and XP with your range rather than forcing big trades; chip off small amounts of HP while taking almost nothing back, and only all-in after several good trades. Level 1: last hit the three melee minions (set one on an off timer, use Q-auto to secure the third) and poke, resetting aggression in brush. At level 2 you can cheese aggressively; otherwise ward river after wave 2 and hard shove wave 3 to crash it before wave 4 arrives. After the crash, pick a cheater recall, a suicide dive with a wall Condemn if they're low, a dive with your jungler if they're at 40-60%, or keep poking and hitting the tower when the enemy jungler is bot. Later, slow-push in 3-wave (or 2-wave) stacks to time recalls, and hold the wave just in front of your tower to freeze so melee opponents must walk into poke. Mid and late game, push safe waves then group for objectives, play front-to-back outside the enemy's key cooldown ranges, or split push the side opposite the objective.
